note: Brunei: ordinary passports of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (the EU, the UK's citizens, North America, the EFTA states), 30 or 14 days (Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order 1985 as amended); Australia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and Saudi Arabia take a visa on arrival (30 days). Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Brunei
sources.said: Holders of ordinary passports of the following countries and territories may enter Brunei without a visa for stays up to the duration listed below: 90 days All European Union member states Canada Iceland Liechtenstein Norway Switzerland United Kingdom United States 30 days Japan Laos Malaysia New Zealand Oman Singapore South Korea Turkey Ukraine United Arab Emirates 14 days Cambodia China Costa Rica Hong Kong Indonesia Kosovo Macau Maldives Myanmar Peru Philippines Russia Taiwan Thailand Vietnam ... 30 days Australia Bahrain Kuwait Qatar Saudi Arabia All nationals above may apply for a single entry visa for B$20, valid for 30 days.
